description:
Another entry in the Yames game collection, Water Womb World is a short free horror game described as an "adventure in Aqua Catholicism where you explore man's original sin at the bottom of the sea floor". There's something louder than a whale down here, but no whales will make an appearance.
Support Yames creepy games at: https://www.patreon.com/yames_games
